scene.bubble: The examiner will ask about YOU: your family, your hobbies, your school. Let's practise with my microphone!
scene.intro: The examiner will ask about YOU, says Diego, so let's practise. What's your surname? How do you spell it? How old are you? Where are you from? What's your favourite subject? Have you got any brothers or sisters? What do you do at the weekend? Kili answers everything about himself, in detail, for eleven minutes. Answer these questions about you — clearly and calmly!

data.script: Diego: Practice exam! What's your name and surname? … Carla: My name is Carla Quispe. … Diego: How old are you, Carla? … Carla: I'm eleven. My birthday was in June. … Diego: Tell me about your family. … Carla: I live with my mum, my grandpa and my two brothers. … Diego: What do you like doing after school? … Carla: I love drawing. I draw animals — mostly llamas! … Diego: And what do you want to be in the future? … Carla: An artist… or maybe a vet for llamas. … Diego: Perfect answers, Carla! The real exam will be easy for you.

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the school courtyard? The boy in the red shirt with a microphone. … Maya: That is Diego. Diego is asking questions with his microphone. … Diego: And who is the big black bird with a white collar? … Maya: That is Kili. Look, Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the boy with very short hair and a white and green shirt? … Maya: That is Tino. Look, Tino is playing hockey. … Diego: And who is the girl with a red ponytail and freckles? … Maya: That is Iris. Look, Iris is drawing with chalk on the ground. … Diego: And who is the man in the blue shirt? … Maya: That is Mr Vega. Look, Mr Vega is showing the way to the sports centre.
